title: TreeCalc corpus case file
description: A themed file of spec-derived cases. Per-kind required fields and cross-references (caller/target exist in the named workspace, known profile verdicts) are enforced by tools/validate-corpus.ps1, which is easier than JSON Schema conditionals for these invariants.

workset.description: Owning workset (WORKSET_REGISTER) whose completion activates these cases.

status.description: pending = authored + well-formed, no executable runner yet; active = wired to a runner. Flip pending->active as the owning workset lands.

profile.description: Active profile for resolution/classification/syntax cases (default treecalc-v1).

caller.description: resolution: node_id of the calling node.

reference.description: The surface reference string under test.

expect.description: Outcome assertion. Shape depends on kind; see the case-kinds table in README.md.

target.description: node_id of the resolved node, or '/' for the workspace root.

engine_ref.description: Intended TreeReference mapping (§3.7); human-readable and not parsed by active runners.

engine_ref_shape.description: Optional structured TreeReference shape consumed by active runners that need to construct prepared references.

profiles.description: profile kind: maps a profile id to 'accept'/'reject' or { verdict, as }.

excel.description: import kind: the Excel input (sheets, defined_names).

members.description: cycle kind: node_ids forming the cycle region (the SCC).

config.description: cycle kind: host cycle configuration — { profile, max_iterations?, max_change? } (§7a).

given.description: dynamic kind: runtime text values of nodes that drive a dynamic (INDIRECT) reference, keyed by node_id.
